description: Get a live SideSwap market-swap quote between DePix, L-BTC and USDt (NON-custodial — the swap pays back into your OWN wallet). Returns a single-use swap_quote_id to pass to wallet_swap_execute before expires_at_ms. amount_sats and the quoted amounts are BASE UNITS. Opens a short-lived quote socket held server-side until you execute, it expires, or the server shuts down. Moves no money by itself.

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

from.description: A Liquid asset: DEPIX (BRL-pegged), LBTC (L-BTC) or USDT (USDt).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the first quote tick, in seconds (default 20, hard ceiling 60).

to.description: A Liquid asset: DEPIX (BRL-pegged), LBTC (L-BTC) or USDT (USDt).

name: wallet_swap_quote

expires_at_ms.description: Absolute epoch-ms deadline; wallet_swap_execute refuses within a few seconds of it.

fee_asset.description: Liquid asset id the fee is charged in, or null.

recv_amount_sats.description: Base units of `to` that will be RECEIVED (validated against the PSET on execute).

send_amount_sats.description: Base units of `from` that will LEAVE the wallet (dealer-quoted send side).

swap_quote_id.description: Single-use handle — pass to wallet_swap_execute BEFORE expires_at_ms. Bound to a live quote socket.

ttl_ms.description: Quote time-to-live in milliseconds from issuance.

title: Quote a SideSwap market swap
